reviewedRawJsonBodies.rationale: Admin broadcast notification payloads are restricted to privileged callers before notification fan-out occurs.
Content report actions are admin-reviewed state transitions and must remain behind server-side role checks.
Firesale moderation actions are privileged workflow mutations protected by Edge-side authorization checks.
Invitation approval and rejection bodies are evaluated only after admin authorization has been checked.
Agent data input actions use manual action guards and are tracked for migration to shared schemas.
AI quota status requests are bounded by typed manual checks before usage counters are read.
AI search request text is normalized and bounded before model routing and filter generation.
Service matching prompts are constrained before provider calls and professional matching logic execute.
Translation bodies are size-limited and normalized before provider requests are constructed.
Data input credit requests are guarded by explicit action checks before credit state is mutated.
Supabase Auth hook payloads follow the provider contract and are handled only within the hook boundary.
Role switch start requests are manually guarded so clients cannot directly grant active privileges.
Onboarding role completion requests use manual role guards before profile or role updates are persisted.
Checkout request bodies are converted to Stripe session parameters only after server-side product checks.
Browser CSP report payloads follow the report-only browser contract and are stored as security telemetry.
Auction enrichment requests are manually constrained before external OS enrichment calls are made.
OS auction fetch pagination is manually guarded before any OS request is executed.
Past deal imports are limited by manual pagination and source guards before OS access.
OS report fetch requests are constrained by manual guards before external report retrieval.
Auction flagging bodies are manually validated before OS-side flag actions are submitted.
Lead follow-up payloads are normalized before AI generation or CRM follow-up actions execute.
Full OS sync request bodies are admin-only and manually guard pagination and replacement options.
Invitation notification bodies are manually checked before outbound notification work begins.
Listing AI assistance requests are bounded before provider routing and generated copy handling.
Role-switch audit bodies are manually guarded so audit entries match allowed role transitions.
Neighbourhood report inputs are normalized before AI generation, market heuristics, and quota tracking.
Open-house registration notification bodies are manually checked before outbound notifications.
Open-house capacity requests are manually guarded before capacity counts are calculated.
OS sales coordinate requests are manually bounded before coordinate enrichment work runs.
Owner Pro status bodies are manually checked before subscription status is resolved.
OS auction polling request bodies are admin-scheduled or admin-triggered and manually bounded.
Pro AI tool messages are bounded before model calls and account-level feature checks.
Project unit price updates are manually guarded before unit pricing rows are changed.
Property chat messages and context are normalized before provider calls are built.
Property POI request bodies are bounded before map, AI, and location enrichment calls.
Property valuation bodies are normalized before AI valuation, quota checks, and market heuristics.
Incoming OS webhook envelopes are parsed only inside the webhook boundary and guarded by webhook checks.
Listing view events are manually bounded before analytics and deduplication writes occur.
Smart filter payloads are normalized before AI extraction and listing filter construction.
Firesale interest submissions are manually guarded before lead records and notifications are created.
Firesale OS sync request bodies are admin-only and guarded before OS-side writes occur.
Listing OS sync request bodies are admin-only and guarded before OS-side writes occur.
Platform admin transfer bodies are privileged and guarded before any admin ownership mutation.
